title: Male And Female
definition: The doctrine of male and female concerns God's creation of humanity as male and female.
summary: Scripture teaches about God's creation of humanity as male and female. This doctrine is presented in a Christ-centered, discipleship-focused way for teaching, ministry, and personal growth.
christFocus: Jesus Christ provides the clearest understanding of male and female and its place in God's redemptive plan.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Biblical teaching regarding male and female.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine helps believers think biblically, follow Christ faithfully, and apply truth in everyday life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Study this truth in Scripture, pray through it, and apply it in obedience to Christ.
